$comment: Rail activation records — the proof gate that sits in front of X402_POLYGON_ENABLED. A non-Base rail enters accepts[] ONLY when (a) its env flag is set AND (b) a VALID activation record here (or in X402_POLYGON_ACTIVATION_RECORD) attests the release-gate ritual passed, OR an explicit emergency override env is set. The flag alone is intentionally NOT enough: the failed Polygon canary (eip155:137 advertised before Layer 3 proved settlement, live verification failed) is exactly what this gate prevents. To activate Polygon, set polygon.activated=true and fill amoy_layer3_passes (>=3) + mainnet_smoke_tx after running test/x402-facilitator/ Layer 3 per docs/x402-facilitator-testing.md. See functions/_lib/x402-rail-activation.js for the validation contract.

polygon.note: Disabled after the failed canary. Activation requires Amoy Layer 3 passing >=3x and a documented mainnet smoke tx hash (see docs/x402-facilitator-testing.md).
